skyBrightness.title: How bright is your sky?
skyBrightness.intro: Where you live is lit, and the faint stars go. Tell the app where you observe from and the screen will show you only as much as you would really see.
skyBrightness.downtownDesc: Down to about magnitude 2. A few dozen stars, and neither the Milky Way nor the Andromeda Galaxy
skyBrightness.cityDesc: Down to about magnitude 4. All seven stars of the Big Dipper, but no Milky Way
skyBrightness.suburbDesc: Down to about magnitude 5. The Milky Way shows faintly overhead
skyBrightness.countryDesc: Down to about magnitude 6. The Milky Way is clear and the Andromeda Galaxy reaches the naked eye
skyBrightness.darkDesc: Past magnitude 7. The Milky Way casts a shadow on the ground
skyBrightness.lessonNote: Lessons always run on a dark countryside sky, because that is the sky their text was written against.

log.storageNote: The log lives in this browser only. Nothing is sent to a server, so nobody else can read it, but it goes if you clear your browser data or open the site on another device. Export anything you want to keep.
